{"metadata":{"description":"Per-session automatic compaction threshold for DeepSeek Harness: a compaction backend whose trigger percentage is stored per session and adjustable from the Web composer while the session runs.","id":"gh:1389421771","install_available":false,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-compaction-threshold","slug":"windwhiterain/dsh-compaction-threshold","topics":["agent","compaction","context-window","cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Per-session automatic compaction threshold for DeepSeek Harness: a compaction backend whose trigger "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"percentage is stored per session and adjustable from the Web composer while the session runs."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-compaction-threshold"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Per-session automatic compaction threshold for DeepSeek Harness, adjustable from the Web composer "},{"id":"p3s2","text":"while a session runs.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"The shipped backend (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic`) fixes the trigger
percentage in the agent "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"preset: one number for every session that preset serves,
changeable only by editing YAML and reloadi"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ng the host. That is the wrong
granularity for real work — a long refactor wants to compact late and"},{"id":"p4s4","text":" keep its
history verbatim, a scratch session wants to compact early and stay cheap, and
neither sho"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"uld require a host restart."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"This plugin keeps the same compaction transaction and makes the percentage **per
session**: a chip b"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"eside the permission and model chips shows the value, a menu
changes it in one click, `/compaction-t"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"hreshold` does the same from the keyboard,
and the value is stored durably beside the session log so"},{"id":"p5s4","text":" it survives a restart.
A forked session and a delegated subagent inherit their parent's value."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The package is **third-party**, and it is honest about its coupling: a compaction
backend must be a "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"subclass of the shipped engine, so unlike a plugin that only
talks to the Cordis context, this one i"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"mports
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic` and copies its trigger policy. Read
Known limitations bef"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"ore upgrading the harness."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- What it looks like

- Developing against a dev host
- Known limitations"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## What it looks like"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"The chip sits with the permission and model chips in the composer, and shows the
session's current p"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"its with the permission and model chips in the composer, and shows the
session's current percentage:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The menu offers the preset default and 30 %–100 %. Here the session is a fork
that inherited its par"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ent's 70 %, so the menu also states where the value came
from:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Once a request has been measured, the chip's tooltip and the menu heading report
the token count the"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" trigger resolved to, so the percentage in force is visible
rather than implied."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Then wire two rows into `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` — one on the host
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Two rows, because a compaction backend and the interface that configures it live
on different planes"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"wo rows, because a compaction backend and the interface that configures it live
on different planes:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| Row | Plane | Owns |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| `dsh-compaction-threshold` | Host | The storage domain keyed by Session id, the `compactionThresho"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ld` Session projection, and the `/compaction-threshold` command |
| `dsh-compaction-threshold/engine"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"` | Agent preset, inside its `compaction` group | The `ctx.compaction` service: the shipped engine w"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"ith a per-session pressure ratio |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The engine reads the value synchronously from the host service and falls back to
its own configured "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"`thresholdRatio` when the host row is absent, so a miswired
composition degrades to the shipped beha"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"viour instead of disabling compaction.
Context-overflow recovery, retention, pruning, retries, and s"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"ummarization are
inherited unchanged."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### Why the override lives in a storage domain, not the session log"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The Session persistence reader refuses an event type outside the generated
known-type catalog unless"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" the record carries `ignorable: true`
(`packages/session/session-persistence/src/storage-contract.ts"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"`), and
`Session.append()` cannot set that marker. A plugin outside the harness
repository therefore"},{"id":"p21s4","text":" cannot add a Session event: its own logs would stop loading.
The override is non-session applicatio"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"n data, so it belongs in
`ctx.storageDomain`, and the client is notified through a Session projectio"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"n —
which is key-addressed and needs no client code per domain."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"#### What the model sees"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Nothing directly: the plugin adds no tool and no prompt text. Indirectly it
changes when a `<compact"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ed-summary>` checkpoint replaces older history and how
much recent history stays verbatim, exactly a"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"s the shipped backend does."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- **One divergence from the shipped backend, by design.** The threshold is a
plain window fraction; "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"the shipped backend would cap it at
`window − outputReservation − headroomTokens`, which can compres"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"s the whole
25 %–100 % range of the knob onto one value. Span selection, the summarization
transacti"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"on, retention, pruning, and retries are still transcribed from
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic` 0"},{"id":"p25s5","text":".1.7-rc.1 (`src/region.ts`
`selectCompactableRange` and the engine's transaction). Those internals a"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"re not
exported, so an upstream change must be mirrored here by hand, and the `Config`
schema is inh"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"erited from the installed package rather than owned. The probe
pins the arithmetic, not upstream fil"},{"id":"p25s8","text":"e contents.
- **A high percentage can still hit a provider overflow.** The request must fit
the prov"},{"id":"p25s9","text":"ider's window with its reserved completion, and the upstream recovery
path compacts on a provider-co"},{"id":"p25s10","text":"nfirmed overflow without consulting the ratio. A
percentage controls the threshold; the provider con"},{"id":"p25s11","text":"trols its own limit.
- **A threshold cannot fix pressure that lives in the tool schemas.** Compactio"},{"id":"p25s12","text":"n
is only attempted when the budget is crossed, and the transaction refuses a
summary that is not sm"},{"id":"p25s13","text":"aller than the span it replaces. In a deployment whose
declared window is barely larger than its own"},{"id":"p25s14","text":" tool catalog, the engine prunes,
tries a summary, and honestly reports
`summary is not smaller than"},{"id":"p25s15","text":" the shadowed content`. A ratio changes *when* the
engine tries; it cannot create headroom the surfa"},{"id":"p25s16","text":"ce does not hold.
- **A snapshot is taken at the child's first observation, not at the fork.**
The S"},{"id":"p25s17","text":"ession store emits no creation or fork event, so lineage is read from
`SessionHeader.parentSession` "},{"id":"p25s18","text":"and the copy happens the first time the child is
read (the engine's pressure check or the projection"},{"id":"p25s19","text":"). An ancestor that changes
its value between the fork and that first observation is what the child
"},{"id":"p25s20","text":"inherits, and a child that owns no record yet still inherits a value its
ancestor sets later; owning"},{"id":"p25s21","text":" any record spends the inheritance for good.
